73556cd877009c830343e2fc92e039d9281cc9c3.author: Azzinoth
73556cd877009c830343e2fc92e039d9281cc9c3.message: FEShader::GetUniform now looks up uniform once, previously it called find and then operator[], so every found uniform was hashed twice; FEShader::GetUniform, UpdateUniformData, LoadUniformDataToGPU and GetUniformData now take uniform name as const std::string&; Added FEShader::FindUniform, it returns nullptr without logging warning when shader does not have uniform; FEShader::GetUniform and HasUniform now use FEShader::FindUniform; FERenderer::LoadStandardUniforms now gets each uniform once with FEShader::FindUniform and sets its value directly.

7c9da1abcb6bbb549a50ecacd301d7e7e8f3776c.author: Azzinoth
7c9da1abcb6bbb549a50ecacd301d7e7e8f3776c.message: FreeCameraController now takes pitch and yaw from view direction of camera on first active frame, previously they were taken from Euler angles, which could contain 180 degrees roll, so camera that was saved facing more than 90 degrees away from default direction was flipped upside down when it was activated; Rotation of FreeCameraController no longer depends on frame time, previously mouse movement was multiplied by delta time, so camera rotated faster on lower FPS; Added FreeCameraController::MouseSensitivity script field, it is degrees of rotation per pixel of mouse movement; Rebuilt camera scripts module with these changes; FEngine::GetDeltaTime now returns time between starts of two frames, previously it was sum of CPU and GPU time, which did not include anything application does between FEngine::Render and FEngine::EndFrame, so in editor delta time was shorter than real frame by time of its user interface; Delta time of the first frame is 0.

c9903f668588f7a0387fe2accdab02cbdcd1d915.message: Updated FEBasicApplication submodule to the latest version; Compressed textures now keep mipmap levels of their file, previously every level was generated again after loading; All levels of a texture that is not square are now loaded, previously the smallest ones were skipped; Added FE_GL_CLEAR_ERRORS.

cefcbb696dce62bdb60dd4e8f5cc696333b6eae4.author: Azzinoth
cefcbb696dce62bdb60dd4e8f5cc696333b6eae4.message: FEGBuffer and FESSAO now delete their framebuffers in destructors, previously framebuffers and all G-buffer textures were leaked every time camera rendering data was recreated; FECameraRenderingData now deletes post process effects that were created by renderer, they are stored in EngineProvidedPostProcessEffects, effects added by application are not deleted; FEPostProcess now deletes its stages; FERenderer::InitializeComputeShaderPointCloudRendering now frees initial data of point cloud buffer after it is uploaded to GPU; FEMesh now deletes its index, position, color, normal, tangent, UV and material index buffers in destructor, previously only VAO was deleted; FEResourceManager::AddColorToFEMeshVertices now deletes old color buffer before creating new one; FEMesh::GetTrianglePositions and GetTriangleUVs now free buffers with data that was read from GPU; FEPointCloud now deletes its compute shader buffers in destructor; FEResourceManager::SetUpPointCloudGPUBuffers now deletes and clears additional compute shader buffers before creating new ones; FELineCollection now stores ID of quad buffer in QuadBufferID and deletes quad and line buffers in destructor; FEGLTFLoader::Clear now frees data of loaded buffers, previously whole .bin file was leaked on every import; FEResourceManager::SaveFENativeScriptModule now frees copies of script and project asset packages after they are written to file; LoadTextureFileAsync now deletes its input data as LoadTextureAsyncInfo, previously it was deleted as void*, so file path was leaked; LoadTextureFileAsyncCallBack now frees file data with delete[]; FETerrainSystem::SetHeightMap, SaveTerrainLayerMask, DeleteTerrainLayerMask and LoadTerrainLayerMask now free texture data that was read from GPU; FETerrainSystem::LoadTerrainLayerMask now deletes texture that was loaded from mask file; Cached data of terrain layer maps is now freed with delete[] and is freed when terrain component is destroyed; FETerrainSystem::DuplicateTerrainComponent no longer copies pointers to cached data of layer maps, previously copy and original were sharing the same buffers.

FEGLTFLoader::Clear now frees data of loaded buffers, previously whole .bin file was leaked on every import; FEResourceManager::SaveFENativeScriptModule now frees copies of script and project asset packages after they are written to file; LoadTextureFileAsync now deletes its input data as LoadTextureAsyncInfo, previously it was deleted as void*, so file path was leaked; LoadTextureFileAsyncCallBack now frees file data with delete[]; FETerrainSystem::SetHeightMap, SaveTerrainLayerMask, DeleteTerrainLayerMask and LoadTerrainLayerMask now free texture data that was read from GPU; FETerrainSystem::LoadTerrainLayerMask now deletes texture that was loaded from mask file; Cached data of terrain layer maps is now freed with delete[] and is freed when terrain component is destroyed; FETerrainSystem::DuplicateTerrainComponent no longer copies pointers to cached data of layer maps, previously copy and original were sharing the same buffers.
